t: You're looking at the St Lawrence and Mary Magdalene Drinking Fountain, on the eastern side of Carter Lane Gardens, close to St Paul's Cathedral. It was made by Joseph Durham, an English sculptor who lived from 1814 to 1877. The material I have on the fountain is brief, so I'll keep it so. It's a small piece of Victorian street furniture, tucked into a garden just a short way from one of London's great landmarks.
